name: NASA Open Data
tagline: Unified gateway to NASA space datasets and APIs
description: NASA Open Data (api.nasa.gov) is a free api_key gateway to NASA open science APIs such as Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD), Near Earth Objects (NeoWs), and EPIC Earth imagery. Some older cataloged endpoints are archived: the Mars Rover Photos API and the legacy Earth (Landsat) API are no longer current. Earthdata GIBS and the NASA Image and Video Library are separate NASA services with their own base URLs and authentication (not this gateway).

auth.details: DEMO_KEY or personal API key via api_key query parameter; free self-serve signup at api.nasa.gov

pricing.free_tier_limits: DEMO_KEY: 30 req/hour, 50 req/day; registered key: 1,000 req/hour

rate_limits: DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/hour and 50 requests/day; registered API key: 1,000 requests/hour
use_cases: fetch Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD)
list Mars rover photos by sol or earth date
query Near Earth Objects (asteroids) by date
get Earth Landsat imagery for lat/lon
search NASA image and video library
